texts.label: BnF fr. 3985 no. 7 (f. 20), Dr Mauclerc to Creil, Paris 3-4 Aug 1593; decipherment no. 4 (f. 7)
texts.summary: Mauclerc reports from League Paris: the Spaniards' offer to marry the Infanta to the Duke of Guise and name them king and queen jointly; Mayenne's show of welcome and then his impossible conditions ('il ne vouloit alium esse Regem Galliae'); the election turned into a truce, to the dishonour of the Estates General; Mayenne, Guise and the princes sworn before the Legate never to make peace with Navarre; the Spaniards' hope that the Pope will keep his promise to the Duke of Sessa and shut the door on Navarre's envoy as on Cardinal Gondi; 'dans trois mois creabitur Rex vel etiam invito du Mayne'. Deciphered at the time: the decipherment is a separate leaf in the same volume (no. 4, f. 7, Gallica view 15).

reading_review.note: Read 23 Oct 2026 (b30): the volume's own inventory (Gallica manifest) shows the cipher letter is no. 7, f. 20 (view 41), and its decipherment a separate leaf, no. 4, f. 7 (view 15; 'Deschiffrement de la lectre du docteur Mauclerc'); there is no interlinear decipherment and views 6-13 are other items. f. 7 transcribed for the first time from the full-size IIIF image; checked against the cipher's clear-written anchor words only (no key in the repository). No word supplied; 8 doubtful words [?] and about 14 short holes [...] in a difficult secretary hand. Body 0.673 clean sentences (37/55), explicit holes 0.909 (50/55); unclean sentences are mostly the Latin passages.
